user.title: Zyxel Switch
user.description: Enter the address of the switch and its SNMP community. SNMP v2c must be enabled on the switch, read access is enough.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the switch.
data_description.community: The read-only community configured on the switch (not your login password).

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or SNMP community of the switch.

error.cannot_connect: The switch did not answer. Check the address, that SNMP v2c is enabled, the community, and whether the switch only accepts SNMP from certain hosts.
error.invalid_response: The switch answered, but not with the expected SNMP data.
error.invalid_host: The host name could not be resolved.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.
abort.wrong_switch: The address now points to a different switch (serial number does not match).

data_description.scan_interval: How often all ports are read. Traffic is averaged over this interval.
